title: YouTubeRelayStaticRecoveryResolveResponse
description: Confirmed resolution of a live_api_relay_static recovery claim. This response never returns an RTMPS address, stream key, OAuth credential, or provider error body.

cleanup.description: provider_delete confirms Control Panel deleted the known unstarted YouTube Broadcast (404 is also confirmed); provider_complete confirms a possibly-dispatched Broadcast was completed after the assigned Encoder acknowledged its stop; operator_confirmed_unknown_broadcast records the explicit attestation required after an insert response was lost; operator_confirmed_provider_cleanup records an explicit provider-cleanup attestation after a confirmed Encoder stop when automatic completion remained unconfirmed.

relay_binding_id.description: Non-secret fixed relay binding identity released by this resolution.
